concept.name: Adequate Effort Society
concept.audience: office workers, remote workers, students and dry-humor gift buyers
concept.theme: deadpan celebration of getting enough done
concept.visual: Original faux institutional seal with a tiny checked box, modest sunrise and deliberately understated rays; no third-party logos, characters or copied artwork.
concept.style: retro office ephemera, deadpan institutional humor, bold readable type, imperfect hand-inked linework, transparent background
concept.placement: centered mug graphic with generous safe area
